title: RocketPoolDecentralizedFrontend
tagline: Using the Near Blockchain Operating System to build a decentralized app on BOS.GG, integrated with RocketPool to offer quick swaps on Ethereum
description:
This project is focused on building a decentralized application (DApp) on the Near Blockchain Operating System (BOS) in conjunction with the BOS.GG platform. The DApp will be integrated with RocketPool, a decentralized infrastructure for Ethereum's proof-of-stake protocol, to offer quick and seamless swaps of Ethereum (ETH) tokens.

The Near Blockchain Operating System (BOS) is a powerful infrastructure designed to make it easy for developers to create and deploy decentralized applications. BOS.GG is a platform built on the Near Protocol that offers a wide range of tools and resources for developers to create DApps on top of the Near Protocol.

RocketPool is a decentralized infrastructure that allows users to earn interest on their ETH by staking it in the Ethereum network. By integrating with RocketPool, the DApp built on BOS.GG will enable users to quickly and easily swap ETH tokens in and out of RocketPool, allowing them to take advantage of its attractive interest rates.
